name: Neon & Bones
storyline: Las Vegas, April 1957. The Chicago Family hands the player a casino on the Strip. Every night the count room closes at ten, and the player decides where the take goes before anyone writes it down: the tax man, the Family, the crew or their own pocket. Over seven chapters (1957-1961) the story moves through a sit-down with the Cleveland boss, a raid with sixty seconds to burn the ledger and a Senate committee hearing, while somebody in the crew is talking to the FBI.
summary: Neon & Bones is a management game set in Las Vegas in 1957. The player runs a casino for the Chicago mob and each night splits the take between taxes, the Family, the crew and their own pocket; skimming too little angers the Family, skimming too much draws the FBI. The game features a seven-chapter story campaign (1957-1961), casino floor building, property and casino acquisitions on the Strip, a 30-day Season mode and three multiplayer modes (Quick War, Shared House, Shared Strip). Available in English and Czech.
